interestingFact: The USA has the largest economy in the world and leads globally in technological innovation, entertainment, and financial markets.
China is the world's manufacturing hub and the most populous country, featuring a rapidly growing tech sector and the historic Great Wall.
Germany is Europe's largest economy, famous for its high-quality automotive industry, precision engineering, and the Autobahn network.
Japan seamlessly blends advanced modern technology with deep traditional culture. It is known for its robotics, electronics, and anime.
India is the fastest-growing major economy and the world's largest democracy, fueled by an exploding IT sector and massive domestic market.
The UK continues to be a major global financial center and has massive soft-power influence globally through education, sports, and media.
France is the most visited country in the world and dominates global markets in aerospace, luxury goods, cosmetics, and culinary arts.
Brazil is Latin America's top economic powerhouse. It holds massive agricultural exports and plays a critical role in global climate balance.
Italy has the most UNESCO World Heritage Sites globally and is renowned for its high-end fashion, exotic supercars, and culinary influence.
Canada is extremely rich in natural resources, ranking among the highest globally in standard of living and high-tech manufacturing.
